import_instructions: Review-only standalone truck calculator package. Run scripts/import_tcg_package.py from OCERP/backend with --validate-only, --dry-run, then --cleanup for an idempotent import.

provenance.extraction_note: Truck calculator resources and CostItems were originally added to the TCG v4 review package; this package separates them under Bedrock truck-specific codes.

summary.scope: Standalone review package for Bedrock truck operating, maintenance, fuel, driving labor, truck capacity metadata, and observed local round-trip CostItems.
